system.description:
AURA ESHARI

Those who stand beside you feel their souls settle more firmly into their bodies.
While you are conscious, allies within 10 feet gain a +1-status bonus to saving throws against possession, Soul Drain and effects with the Soul trait.

Prerequisites Level 15, Soul-Hardened

Works automatically as an aura: allies within 10 feet get +1 status to saves against possession, Soul Drain and Soul-trait effects — offered in their save dialogs while they stand near you (an ally-aura conditional).
